instruction: I bought a few Hanes Men's Tagless Crewneck Undershirts on amazon this week. But only the one in extra-large size fits me well. Initiate a return for the rest. Prefer UPS as a deliverer, if available.
notes: Single-app Amazon task. The undershirt purchases are modeled as three size variants (XL fits; two others do not) inside one order found by show_orders with the product-name query and detailed by show_order; initiate_return is allowed only for non-fitting items, with the purchased quantity (1) and the preferred deliverer (UPS, static fact). show_return_deliverers needs no token and sets a nullary deliverers-known flag. supervisor-complete-task takes the returned order/items as record parameters so its precondition (two distinct returns in the order) equals the goal; it carries no answer since the task is not a question. If the items were spread over several orders the agent would repeat show_order per order; no deletions or other DB changes are required.
